orientation_convention:
Canonical hold for all downstream enclosure work — Easyduino family portrait stick, component face toward the user, USB end at the bottom [citation: easyduino-esp32-enclosure/stages/02-orient.json; enclosure-forge/traces/lm/easyesp32s3-s2-orient-lm.json]. Long axis (v, 51.0 mm) vertical; width axis (u, 21.0 mm) horizontal; board-local (u,v) = KiCad (X-x0, Y-y0) per the extraction frame [citation: easy-Easyduino_RP2040/pcb_geometry.json coordinate_note + outline].
- **Bottom end (functional anchor) = v=0 edge:** hosts J1, the only edge-mating connector; mouth set ~1.4 mm in from the board edge, u-center 10.68; cable inserts horizontally, plug axis parallel to v [citation: easy-Easyduino_RP2040/component_geometry.json J1; board_context README excerpt "USB ... at one end"]. NOTE: family predecessors had USB at v-max — this board's bottom wall is v=0; carrying the family coordinate instead of the family rule is the portrait-window bug [citation: easyduino-esp32-enclosure/README.md (that board's v-max opening) vs component_geometry.json J1 v[1.4,7.72] (this board); enclosure-forge/references/lessons.md L6].
- **Top end = v=51 edge:** J5 3-pin header abutting the end wall on the u-min half (u 1.99–8.77) and J6 JST-SH 3-pin centered at u=10.5, 4.2 mm clear of the wall; both service from the component face [citation: easy-Easyduino_RP2040/component_geometry.json J5/J6].
- **User-facing face = populated/component face**, origin of all extracted heights (0.5–8.5 mm); opposite face rests on the tray floor [citation: easy-Easyduino_RP2040/component_geometry.json heights column].
- **Flanks:** J3 1x20 rail on the u=0 edge, J4 1x20 rail on the u=21 edge, both spanning v 0.469–50.429 (essentially full length) — a mirror pair, no handedness [citation: easy-Easyduino_RP2040/component_geometry.json J3/J4].
- **Handedness (mirror discriminator), in the canonical hold** (component face toward user, USB at bottom — a 180° in-plane rotation from the extraction-plot view, which mirrors the u axis per L7): the SW1/SW2 button pair is on the user's RIGHT (u-min half), the D2/D3/D4 LED column on the user's LEFT (u-max half), J5's window at the top end's RIGHT half. A design with buttons left / LEDs right / J5 top-left is mirrored and wrong even with all booleans green [citation: easy-Easyduino_RP2040/component_geometry.json SW1/SW2/D2/D3/D4/J5; enclosure-forge/references/lessons.md L7].
- **What the user sees, bottom to top:** USB-C opening centered in the bottom wall; button pair right-of-centerline and LED column left-of-centerline at the lower third (v≈9.7–20.5); RP2040 QFN-56 at center (u-center 10.59, v-center 29.7); JST-SH J6 centered at upper third; J5 at top-right of the top end; twin 20-pin rails down both flanks [citation: easy-Easyduino_RP2040/component_geometry.json J1/SW1/SW2/D2/D3/D4/U2/J6/J5/J3/J4].
- **Mounting holes are NOT orientation evidence:** 4x Ø2.2 at (3.99, 2.3), (17.39, 2.3), (3.99, 48.7), (16.59, 48.7) — near-symmetric under rotation/mirror (row centers 10.69/10.29, a ~0.4 mm offset; corroborating only). README excerpt says "castellated+drilled"; the operative drilled diameter is the measured 2.2 [citation: easy-Easyduino_RP2040/pcb_geometry.json mounting_holes; board_context README excerpt].
- **Explicit limits:** hold direction not documented for this board (family precedent only); no display, no antenna module in the extracted parts, so no window-orientation or RF keep-out surface exists [citation: board_context README excerpt; easy-Easyduino_RP2040/component_geometry.json parts list].
user_facing_features:
Mapped through the convention (board-local u/v → case: v=0 wall = bottom, v=51 wall = top, populated face = lid/access side):
1. **USB port opening (J1)** — bottom wall (v=0), centered u=10.68 (shell span u 5.86–15.5, width 9.64 mm), 3.3 mm proud of the component face, mouth 1.4 mm in from the edge; cable approaches perpendicular to the wall, insertion +v. CUT FOR THE MEASURED USB-C SHELL: the README excerpt's "micro-B" contradicts the extracted USB_C_Receptacle_G-Switch_GT-USB-7010ASV footprint — measured wins for the opening shape (doc delta recorded), orientation unaffected since both mate from the same edge [citation: easy-Easyduino_RP2040/component_geometry.json J1; board_context README excerpt]. An opening on any other wall, at the family's v-max wall, or sized micro-B, is a semantic regression booleans will not catch [citation: enclosure-forge/references/lessons.md L6].
2. **GPIO rails (J3, J4)** — 1x20 P2.54 vertical headers, 8.5 mm proud, spanning v 0.469–50.429 along both flanking edges (J3 = u=0 wall = user-right flank; J4 = u=21 wall = user-left flank). Users jumper/probe from the component-face side: both long walls must be open/slotted over that v-band, or the design must be a carrier leaving the flanks exposed [citation: easy-Easyduino_RP2040/component_geometry.json J3/J4].
3. **J5 far-end 3-pin header** — abuts the top wall (v 48.729–50.429, 0.57 mm from the edge), u-min half (u 1.99–8.77; top end's RIGHT half in the canonical hold), 8.5 mm proud. Function undocumented in the excerpt; position/pitch are consistent with the Pico-format end debug-header convention (inference, labeled) — needs top-wall relief or lid access if fitted [citation: easy-Easyduino_RP2040/component_geometry.json J5; board_context README excerpt silent].
4. **J6 JST-SH 3-pin (BM03B-SRSS-TB, vertical)** — centered u=10.5, v 42.6–46.8, extracted height 7.0 mm; top-entry: the plug mates from the component-face (lid) side, NOT through an end wall — a v=51-wall opening for J6 would be a semantic regression. Function undocumented (3-wire sensor/UART class — inference, labeled) [citation: easy-Easyduino_RP2040/component_geometry.json J6 footprint "Vertical"; board_context README excerpt silent].
5. **SW1/SW2 tact buttons** — pair stacked along v on the u-min half (SW2 v 9.755–14.845 nearer the USB end, SW1 v 15.455–20.545 behind it; user-right of centerline in the canonical hold). Extracted height 1.0 mm is height_provenance=conservative_assumption — re-verify before choosing button ports; family precedent keeps buttons under the lid (no openings v1) [citation: easy-Easyduino_RP2040/component_geometry.json SW1/SW2 incl. height_provenance; easyduino-esp32-enclosure/stages/02-orient.json "buttons remain under the lid"].
6. **D2/D3/D4 LED column** — u 15.655–17.215 (u-max half; user-left of centerline), v 16.13–18.77, 0.8 mm tall. If status windows are wanted, they go in this lower-left-quadrant band (one window or a three-window strip); functions undocumented (power/activity guesses — inference, labeled) [citation: easy-Easyduino_RP2040/component_geometry.json D2/D3/D4; board_context README excerpt silent].
7. **Windows/displays: NONE beyond the above.** The parts table contains no display or readout; any additional window or indicator opening is invented, not user-facing [citation: easy-Easyduino_RP2040/component_geometry.json parts list; board_context README excerpt].
8. Support fact (not user-facing): 4x Ø2.2 mounting holes at (3.99, 2.3), (17.39, 2.3), (3.99, 48.7), (16.59, 48.7) for bosses/standoffs only — near-symmetric, never orientation evidence [citation: easy-Easyduino_RP2040/pcb_geometry.json mounting_holes].
